suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add note about cross-crate visibility constraints: before changing any katla_ui public API to pub(crate), check katla_app for cross-crate usage. Several ui-polish sub-tasks (VAL-UI-007 selectable/toggle_button visibility, VAL-UI-008 UiContext field visibility) could not be applied because katla_app accesses these from a separate crate.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature ui-polish: selectable() called from katla_app/src/ui/debug_overlay.rs:301, toggle_button() called from katla_app/src/ui/editor_ui/preferences.rs:371, UiContext fields (input/style/fonts) accessed from katla_app.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the two-layer widget architecture in .factory/library/: public builders in widgets/mod.rs vs internal implementations in context/widgets/. Understanding this split is important for widget-related work — Response::interactive() standardization correctly targets the internal layer where interactive state is managed.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature ui-polish: context/widgets.rs module docstring documents the two-layer pattern but this knowledge isn't surfaced at project level.
